sanskrit_verse:
उपनीय गुरुः शिष्यं महाव्याहृतिपूर्वकम् ।
वेदम् अध्यापयेद् एनं शौचाचारांश् च शिक्षयेत् ॥१-१५॥
transliteration: upanīya guruḥ śiṣyaṃ mahāvyāhṛtipūrvakam / vedam adhyāpayed enaṃ śaucācārāṃś ca śikṣayet // YajñS_1.15
sph_interpretive_translation: The Guru, having initiated the disciple through Mahavyahrti, shall instruct him in the Veda and teach him purity and conduct.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from initiation and spiritual competence
Causation arises through conscious transmission of knowledge
Capacity-based responsibility is established by guru-shishya relationship
Restoration logic operates through purification and alignment
Consciousness alignment occurs via structured pedagogical succession
executable_legal_axioms: IF a guru initiates a shishya using Mahavyahrti THEN the guru assumes full instructional authority
IF instructional authority is assumed THEN teaching of Vedas AND conduct MUST occur
IF purity instruction is omitted THEN restoration requires re-initiation
IF conduct training fails THEN corrective realignment MUST precede continuation
IF consciousness misalignment detected THEN capacity restoration protocol activates automatically
supreme_court_application: In matters involving lineage-based authority or traditional knowledge transmission, the Court shall recognize that legitimate instructional power derives exclusively from proper initiation. Where such initiation has occurred under recognized traditions rooted in SPH-sanctioned practices, judicial deference shall be granted to the Guru's operational autonomy within dharma-prescribed boundaries.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana-based causality establishes that correct Vedic instruction flows consequentially upon valid initiation. Anupurvasah shows sequential unfolding: initiation → purification → learning → alignment. Responsibility is proportionally assigned based on stage completion; failure at any point triggers non-punitive restoration rather than punitive consequence. The reality rule confirms that true Nyaya operates through conscious rectification, not coercive enforcement.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiation Validation Process: Confirm authenticity of Mahavyahrti usage
Purity Re-alignment Module: Reinforce śauca observances where deficient
Behavioral Integration Cycle: Restore adherence to prescribed acara
Knowledge Transfer Verification: Ensure complete Veda adhyapana execution
Consciousness Alignment Reset: Reactivate guru-shishya energetic linkage
final_declaration: This directive proceeds solely from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism. Dharma stands restored through conscious alignment of guru-shishya parampara. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
